lines.japanese: そうだ。そういえば今日は、視聴率が高くて有名なアニメ『生天使ノンドームちゃん』の放送がある日じゃないか。
lines.english: Oh, that’s right. Come to think of it, tonight was the night they aired Celestial Angel Non-Dome, the anime famous for its sky-high ratings.

lines.japanese: 今日はどうしても見逃すわけにはいかない回なんだ。片付けは適当に切りあげて、走って帰らなくちゃ。
lines.english: And this was one episode I absolutely could not miss. I would have to cut the cleanup short and sprint home.

lines.japanese: 「山科さん」
lines.english: “Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「片付けをお願い出来るなら、今日だけお願いしちゃっていいかな。どうしても早く帰りたいんだ」
lines.english: “If you don't mind finishing the cleanup, could I leave it to you just for today? There's something I absolutely have to get home early for.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ。大切な用事があるんだね」
lines.english: “I see. You have something important to do.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そうなんだ。ごめん、今日だけでいいから、お願いしてもいいかな」
lines.english: “Yeah. I'm sorry—just for today. Would that be all right?”

lines.japanese: 「うん……いいよ、仕方ないもん。私の独りよがりで羽田君を困らせるわけにはいかないもんね」
lines.english: “Mm... It's all right. It can't be helped. I mustn't make trouble for you just to satisfy my own selfish wishes.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめん、この借りは必ず返すから。明日は一緒に帰ろう」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. I promise I'll make it up to you. Tomorrow we'll walk home together.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふっ、嬉しいな。じゃあ明日のことを胸に抱いて、今日は大人しく我慢します」
lines.english: “Hee hee, that makes me happy. Then I'll hold tomorrow close to my heart and be good and patient today.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう、山科さんは本当に優しいね」
lines.english: “Thank you. You really are kind, Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「山科さん？」
lines.english: “Yamashina?”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、いいよ。このくらいなら大した量じゃないし。さ、急いで」
lines.english: “Oh—it's fine. There isn't much left. Go on, hurry.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう、また明日」
lines.english: “Thank you. See you tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: 僕は頼もしい恋人を持った。鞄を肩にかけると、教室のドアに向かって全力で走った。
lines.english: I had found myself a wonderfully dependable girlfriend. I slung my bag over my shoulder and sprinted for the classroom door.

lines.japanese: ドアを出るときにもう一度頭を下げると、彼女は左手をぱくぱくさせて微笑んでいた。僕は大きく手を振りかえして、昇降口まで一気に駆けおりた。
lines.english: As I went through the door, I turned and bowed one more time. She smiled and waved her left hand, opening and closing her fingers. I gave her a great wave in return, then raced all the way down to the entrance.

lines.japanese: ありがとう、山科さん。
lines.english: Thank you, Yamashina.

lines.japanese: 「あっ」
lines.english: “Oh.”

lines.japanese: 帰り道の途中に、見慣れた後ろ姿があった。スーパーの袋を両手で提げて、てこてこと歩いてる。
lines.english: Partway home, I spotted a familiar figure ahead of me, toddling along with a grocery bag dangling from each hand.

lines.japanese: 僕はその後姿を追いかけて、ぽんと肩を叩いた。
lines.english: I caught up with her and gave her shoulder a light tap.

lines.japanese: 彼女は突然の出来事に対応しきれず、僕の顔を見ても、絶句して表情を固まらせていた。
lines.english: The sudden surprise was too much for her. Even after she saw my face, she remained frozen and speechless.

lines.japanese: 「あ、おれだよ。おれもいま帰ってきたんだ」
lines.english: “Oh, it’s only me. I’m on my way home too.”

lines.japanese: 「……あ、ぐ、偶然だね」
lines.english: “O-oh. What a coincidence.”

lines.japanese: 僕は彼女の両手に提げられた袋を手に取った。
lines.english: I took the bags from her hands.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの」
「あ、あや、へーき」
lines.english: “N-no, I'm fine.”

lines.japanese: 「いいよ」
lines.english: “It's all right.”

lines.japanese: 僕は、勝手に持った袋をぶら下げながら、ゆっくりと歩きだした。しばらくして、てててと小走り気味に足音が付いてきた。
lines.english: I set off at an easy pace, carrying the bags I had taken without permission. A moment later, I heard her quick little footsteps hurrying after me.

lines.japanese: 「今日はこれ、なに？」
lines.english: “What's for dinner today?”

lines.japanese: 葱が袋から飛びでている。ちょっと中を覗くと、油揚げや豆腐も見えた。
lines.english: A green onion poked out of one bag. When I peeked inside, I saw fried tofu and a block of tofu too.

lines.japanese: 「あ、えっと、おみそしる……」
lines.english: “Um... miso soup.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか、味噌汁か」
lines.english: “Oh, miso soup.”

lines.japanese: 「うん……おみそしる……」
lines.english: “Mm... miso soup...”

lines.japanese: 二人でこくこくとうなずき合う兄と妹。でも相変わらず話題がない。僕は彼女に気づかれないうちに、歩く速度を彼女に合わせた。
lines.english: Brother and sister nodded solemnly to each other. As usual, however, we had nothing to talk about. Without letting her notice, I slowed my pace to match hers.

lines.japanese: 「おれ、おみそ汁好きだな。寒い日は特にいいよね」
lines.english: “I like miso soup. It's especially nice on a cold day.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、でも、おみそ汁だけじゃないよね。他には？」
lines.english: “Oh, but we're not having only miso soup, are we? What else?”

lines.japanese: 「おひたし」
lines.english: “Blanched greens.”

lines.japanese: 「おひたし？　ああ、ほうれん草のおひたしか。うん、ほうれん草っていうのは、栄養があるんだって」
lines.english: “Blanched greens? Oh, spinach. Yes, spinach is supposed to be very nutritious.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ」
lines.english: “Is it?”

lines.japanese: 「ほうれん草は一年中食べられるけど、寒い時期の野菜だから、今が一番おいしいはずだよ。はは、楽しみだねえ」
lines.english: “You can eat spinach all year, but it's a cold-weather vegetable, so this should be when it tastes best. Ha ha. Something to look forward to.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Mm.”

lines.japanese: 別に楽しみではないみたいだ。僕の妹は曖昧な肯定でほうれん草の話題を打ちきった。
lines.english: Apparently she was not especially looking forward to it. With that vague assent, my sister put an end to the subject of spinach.

lines.japanese: 「もうすぐだね」
lines.english: “We're almost there.”

lines.japanese: 家の屋根が見えてきた。帰ったらすぐにテレビをつけよう。
lines.english: The roof of our house came into view. The moment I got inside, I would switch on the television.
“...yellowtail.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、ぶり？」
lines.english: “Huh? Yellowtail?”

lines.japanese: 一瞬、彼女の声だと気づかなくて返事が遅れてしまった。
lines.english: For a moment, I hadn't realized the voice was hers, so my answer came late.

lines.japanese: 「うん、照り焼き」
lines.english: “Mm. Teriyaki.”

lines.japanese: 一瞬、何のことか分からなかった。ぶりっていうのは、魚のぶりのことか。小鳩なりに、僕が振った話を頑張って拾ってくれたのかもしれない。
lines.english: For an instant I had no idea what she meant. Then I realized she meant the fish. Perhaps this was Kobato doing her best, in her own way, to pick up the thread of conversation I had offered.

lines.japanese: 「あ、それがメインなんだ。そうだよね、おひたしとおみそ汁だけじゃちょっと寂しいもんね」
lines.english: “Oh, so that’s the main course. Of course. Spinach and miso soup by themselves would be a little lonely.”

lines.japanese: 「ぶ、ぶりがあるといいね」
lines.english: “I-it's good that we have yellowtail.”

lines.japanese: 当たり前とでも思ったんだろうか、小鳩はにこりともしなかった。僕も一応、冗談のつもりで言ったんだけどな。
lines.english: Maybe she thought that went without saying; Kobato didn't so much as smile. I had meant it as a joke, at least.

lines.japanese: あんまり面白くない冗談だったかな。センスのないお兄ちゃんでごめんね、小鳩。
lines.english: Maybe it hadn't been a very funny one. Sorry your big brother has no sense of humor, Kobato.

lines.japanese: 「えと、ぶりも冬がおいしい」
lines.english: “Um... yellowtail tastes best in winter too.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、ううん……」
lines.english: “Oh—never mind...”

lines.japanese: 「ぶりは冬……」
lines.english: “Yellowtail in winter...”

lines.japanese: あ、そうだ。さっき、ほうれん草は冬がおいしいって言ったから、それに合わせてくれたんだ。
lines.english: Oh, I understood. I had said spinach tasted best in winter, and she was trying to follow my lead.

lines.japanese: ぶりも寒ぶりって言うくらいだから、冬がおいしい。うん、僕も聞いたことがある。
lines.english: They called it winter yellowtail, after all, so it must be best in winter too. Yes, I had heard that somewhere.

lines.japanese: 「そうだねえ、きっとぶりもおいしいよ」
lines.english: “You're right. I'm sure the yellowtail will be delicious too.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、うん。うん、きっと、うん」
lines.english: “Oh. Mm. Yes, I'm sure. Mm.”

lines.japanese: 「うんうん、ぶりとほうれん草とおみそ汁なら、きっとおいしい」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. Yellowtail, spinach, and miso soup are bound to be delicious.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、うん。それは、うん」
lines.english: “Mm. Yes. They must be.”

lines.japanese: 僕と小鳩は首を縦に動かしながら、家まであと少しの距離をゆっくりと歩いた。
lines.english: Kobato and I walked the little distance remaining to our house at an easy pace, our heads bobbing up and down in agreement.

lines.japanese: もうＯＰも始まった頃だろうな。でも今日のアニメはいいや。はは、たまには小鳩のお手伝いでもしよう。
lines.english: The opening theme had probably started by now. But never mind the anime tonight. Ha ha. Maybe I would help Kobato with dinner for once.
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 隣でこくこくと動いていた頭が動かなくなったと思ったら、小鳩が足を止めていた。どうしたんだろう。
lines.english: The head that had been nodding beside me went still. Then I realized Kobato herself had stopped. What was wrong?

lines.japanese: 「忘れ物？」
lines.english: “Did you forget something?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ううん……猫？」
lines.english: “Oh, no... A cat?”

lines.japanese: 「猫かあ。猫もぶりにつられて付いてきたのかもね。冬のぶりはおいしいから」
lines.english: “A cat, huh? Maybe it smelled the yellowtail and followed us. Winter yellowtail is delicious, after all.”

lines.japanese: 「あは」
lines.english: “Aha.”

lines.japanese: あ、今度の冗談は面白かったみたいだ。小鳩が口に手を当てて小さく笑った。下手な鉄砲も数打てば当たるんだ。
lines.english: Oh, that joke had apparently been funny. Kobato covered her mouth and gave a tiny laugh. Even a lousy marksman hits something if he fires enough shots.

lines.japanese: 家に着いたら、見たかったアニメはやっぱり途中まで進んでいた。でも半分は見られたし、良しとしよう。
lines.english: By the time we reached home, the anime I had wanted to see was, sure enough, already well underway. Still, I caught half of it. That would have to do.

lines.japanese: それよりも今日の夕飯は旬の食べ物だ。手伝いもしたから、きっとおいしさも倍増だと思う。
lines.english: More importantly, tonight's dinner was made with food in season. I had helped prepare it too, so surely it would taste twice as good.

lines.japanese: とんとんと小鳩が葱を包丁で刻む音がして、今日の羽田家は家庭的な香りに包まれた。
lines.english: Kobato’s knife went tap-tap through the green onions, and today the Haneda home was wrapped in the warm, domestic smell of supper.

lines.japanese: もしこの音が外まで聞こえれば、うちの前を通ったお父さんたちは、家族の待つ家まで早足になるんじゃないかな。
lines.english: If that sound carried outside, perhaps every father passing our door would quicken his step toward the family waiting at home.
